recipe.build:
sed -r '/create\("release"\) \{/,/        \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle.kts
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i android/app/build.gradle.kts
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/\s*\bFLUTTER_VERSION:\s\"\^?([0-9.]+)\"\s*$/\1/p' .github/workflows/release.yml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
